Common questions

Everything you're wondering about.

How much does the program cost? +
The investment is discussed personally — after Rony reviews your application and understands your specific situation. There is no one-size-fits-all price because there is no one-size-fits-all program. What we can say: most clients tell us it costs far less than the money they wasted on another failed dietitian, another meal plan app, or another month of not changing.
I've tried every diet and failed every time. Why is this different? +
Because every other program gave you a plan and left you alone with it. This program gives you a person who shows up every single day — before you think about quitting, before the boredom hits, before month 2. Zaynab tried 7 dietitians before this. The difference wasn't the meal plan. It was the daily presence.
I have PCOS and insulin resistance. Can I actually lose weight? +
Yes — and these are Rony's specialty, not a disqualifier. Most of his clients come in with PCOS, high insulin, or high cholesterol. The nutrition plan is designed specifically for hormonal conditions. Zaynab had all three — and lost 25kg without a single pill.
I'm a busy mother. I barely have time for myself. Can I realistically do this? +
The coaching runs entirely through WhatsApp — no commute, no extra appointments. Your gym sessions are scheduled into your week like any fixed commitment, and Rony works around your schedule to find the best time slots. Zaynab had 3 kids and a full life. She made it work because Rony was there every day keeping her on track.
Do I need a gym membership? +
Yes — the program is gym-based. That's part of what makes it work. Rony builds your training around real gym equipment, structured progressions, and a plan that your body can actually respond to. If you don't have a membership yet, Rony will help you choose the right gym before you start.
I'm not in Lebanon. Can I still join? +
Yes. The program is 100% online. Rony currently works with women in Lebanon, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, and beyond. If you have WhatsApp, you're in.
Honestly — I don't think I'm disciplined enough. What if I fail again? +
Discipline is not a requirement to start — it's a result of the system. Zaynab wasn't disciplined in the beginning. She became disciplined because someone showed up every single day before she had a chance to quit. That's the whole point. You don't need to be ready. You need someone who won't let you give up.
Every coach I've tried gave me a meal plan and disappeared. How is this different? +
Because a meal plan without daily presence is just a PDF. Any coach who hands you a restriction list and a supplement stack is relying on external factors — and when it stops working, they'll blame your willpower. Rony doesn't do deprivation. He doesn't sell supplements. He works on the root cause: your glands and hormones. Fix what's broken on the inside, and the results follow naturally — and permanently.
